g.text: Execution target, not implemented by the current class-file skeleton
These are runtime objects. Boundary labels are their declared types,
not separate interface objects. Application wiring registers the View listener.
create candidate Order with fixed BUY
REQUIRED account-wide transaction / coordinated atomic commit
compare current cash + this holding with expected
commit cash + target holding + appended history together
Preserve other holdings and prior history.
Stage changes; do not partially mutate a live User.
findById + save signatures alone do not ensure this.
true = committed; false = missing/changed with zero writes
Refresh errors do not undo or reject a committed trade.
Technical I/O failures need separate handling and rollback.
They must not be reported as ACCOUNT_CHANGED or false success.
This sequence is the intended implementation; current methods are TODO scaffolds.
